messages:
Maya (CS): Quick heads-up — BeaconCart (Enterprise) flagged as at-risk. Integration stalled, token usage down ~65% last 30d, renewal in 28 days. Need a short save plan + downgrade-safe path. Anyone available?

Ethan (AM): On it. What specifically is blocked on their side?

Maya (CS): Their engs reported latency regressions after we pushed the quantized variant yesterday. Streaming also failing in staging (hangs on init). No exec call scheduled yet.

Priya (Enablement): I can run a 2h deep-dive tomorrow with their engineers. Will need a compact playbook and a checklist to walk through.

Diego (Product): We can revert BeaconCart to the non-quantized v1.3 variant that was stable. Revert needs sign-off from RevOps for temporary credits and Eng-runtime for the rollback window.

Leo (Solutions): Proposing a 7-day "success sprint":
- Day 0: triage + revert to v1.3-nq
- Day 1: enablement + streaming debug session
- Day 3: measure perf and usage trends
- Day 7: exec ROI call to confirm recovery
Add fallback: downgrade path and prorated billing if unresolved by Day 4.

Maya (CS): That timeline works. We also need a standard downgrade offer so AE has clear talking points (pricing/credits/feature parity).

Remy (RevOps): If they choose to downgrade mid-cycle to Starter, we do prorated credit for overage and can offer 50% off the first month on Starter as a retention incentive. I'll draft the billing snippet and invoice adjustment steps.

Priya (Enablement): Drafting an outreach email + call script — copy below for review:

```
Hi Tim / BeaconCart team —

We noticed increased latency after the recent runtime change and some staging streaming failures. We'd like to do a short 30–45min troubleshooting call to revert to a stable model and confirm streaming settings. We'll also issue a temporary 1-week Starter credit to avoid disruption while we fix this. Are you available Mon/Tue?

Thanks,
Priya (Redwood Enablement)
```

Ethan (AM): Add an exec ask after stabilization: 15min ROI review showing p50/p95 latency, cost per 1k tokens, and any conversion impact. Keep it short and metric-driven.

Diego (Product): Eng-runtime ETA for revert once approved: ~6 hours. After revert we should run a smoke load: 5k sampled requests and confirm p95 < 350ms.

OnboardBot: Created ticket CS-9427 and assigned to eng-runtime. ETA 6h. Meeting link placeholder: https://redwood.app/meet/cs-9427

Maya (CS): Who will own the one-pager playbook to attach to CS-9427? Need a 1-page checklist for AE and a small script for support.

Leo (Solutions): I'll draft the checklist now. Quick draft to iterate on:

```
- Symptom: latency/regressions after quantized variant
- Immediate action: revert to v1.3-nq (record rollback window)
- Troubleshoot: enablement session (2h) + streaming config check
- Temp offer: 1 week Starter credit + 50% off next month if downgrade
- Verify: p95, token usage trend, error rate, streaming success
- Escalate: exec ROI call if not resolved within 72h
- Billing: CC revops for proration template
```

Remy (RevOps): Approved credits. I'll cc billing team and attach the proration template to CS-9427. Also recommend limiting promo to one cycle.

Maya (CS): Plan confirmed: revert today, enablement tomorrow, exec call end of next week. Ethan — please own customer comms. Priya — schedule enablement. Diego — coordinate the revert with eng-runtime. Remy — handle billing proration. Ping here when complete. :thumbsup: 

Ethan (AM): On it. Sending the initial email now and will propose two 30min slots. Will include the playbook checklist and the sprint timeline.

Diego (Product): Revert requested in CS-9427. Eng-runtime, please confirm when complete so Priya can schedule enablement.

eng-runtime (Bot): Revert completed at 1786502000. Smoke tests started (job 9444).

Maya (CS): Quick update — smoke tests show p95 = 320ms and token usage is beginning to recover. Scheduling exec ROI call for Friday 10am. Will update thread after the call. Thanks everyone for the fast turnaround.

Ethan (AM): Noted. I'll prepare a 10-min SLIDE with pre/post metrics for the exec call.

Maya (CS): Closing loop for now — keep this thread for post-call notes and final billing adjustments. If anything regresses, escalate immediately. :handshake:
